3844e5ae-a81b-44a3-b33a-90994711ca01.quote: A quick, clean stomp built on their jungler's respawn timer. We drew first blood, took all three Fangtooths, the Mini Prime and the only Seedling, and took two of their outer towers for one of ours. The sloppy patch came when Murdock and Khaimera both died shortly before our only lost tower, and Sparrow later won one exchange. Those were the only blemishes. The closing ace, followed by the last Fangtooth, finished it.
3844e5ae-a81b-44a3-b33a-90994711ca01.issue: proximity presented as causation: the feed shows each pit followed a Serath death, not that it was taken while Serath was still dead, which the focus evidence itself admits
3844e5ae-a81b-44a3-b33a-90994711ca01.rewrite: A quick, clean stomp in which Serath died seven times. The sloppy patch came when Murdock and Khaimera both died shortly before our only lost tower, and Sparrow later won one exchange. Those were the only blemishes. The closing ace, followed by the last Fangtooth, finished it.

3844e5ae-a81b-44a3-b33a-90994711ca01.quote: Lightning Hawk builds charge while moving or attacking and empowers a basic attack with bonus damage and a slow. Vanquisher adds physical power, penetration and critical chance, and executes a hero who drops very low. Both add critical chance; neither adds sustain or defense. They are the first two items of the common winning core, so on core, nothing here cost a fight.

3844e5ae-a81b-44a3-b33a-90994711ca01.quote: The low hero damage, not survival, is the build question. Zinx healed and Serath built lifesteal, so Tainted Rounds is the comparison against Manta Scythe: healing reduction and on-hit damage on Legion's basic attacks, in exchange for Manta's penetration, lifesteal and faster farming. No enemy finished an armor item, so Deathstalker's armor shred is less urgent than anti-heal in this lobby. This win does not prove the swap was needed.

3844e5ae-a81b-44a3-b33a-90994711ca01.quote: The winning core is Dynamo, Xenia and Frosted Lure. Dynamo makes immobilized enemies take more damage briefly, a direct fit with Riplash and Skewer, and Xenia shields allies within close range. Compared with Transference, that trades Riktor's own shield value for damage and protection the team shares. Riktor never died and had a hand in under a third of our kills, so participation, not survival, is what the next item should serve.
